# Aegis | Enterprise AI Company

> Aegis is an AI company engineering enterprise-grade autonomous agents, voice intelligence, cognitive workflow automations, and proprietary AI architectures for high-growth businesses and modern enterprises.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [AI Voice Agents & Telephony](https://aegis-agency.com/services): Real-time conversational AI for inbound call centers, lead qualification, and customer support with sub-second latency.
- [Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems](https://aegis-agency.com/services): Orchestrated multi-agent pipelines (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) handling complex, multi-step operational tasks autonomously.
- [Enterprise RAG & Knowledge Engines](https://aegis-agency.com/services): Private vector databases, hybrid search (Milvus, Pinecone, Weaviate), and strict SOC2/GDPR compliance.
- [Custom LLM Fine-Tuning & Deployment](https://aegis-agency.com/services): Domain-adapted foundation models with robust security guardrails and high-throughput inference.
- [Process Automation & CRM Integrations](https://aegis-agency.com/services): End-to-end synchronization across Salesforce, HubSpot, SAP, Slack, and legacy ERP systems.
